Title: User Registration
Description: The system shall allow new users to register with username, email, and strong password.

Title: User Authentication
Description: The system shall authenticate users using credentials and issue signed JWT bearer tokens.

Title: Wallet Creation
Description: The system shall automatically provision a digital wallet with a zero balance upon user registration.

Title: Add Simulated Funds
Description: The system shall allow users to add simulated funds to their personal wallet with balance bounds validation.

Title: Merchant Registration
Description: The system shall allow registered users to create a verified merchant profile with business details and API credentials.

Title: Payment Initiation
Description: The system shall allow authenticated users to initiate simulated payments towards verified merchants.

Title: Payment Confirmation
Description: The system shall atomically debit the sender and credit the merchant upon payment confirmation.

Title: Refund Processing
Description: The system shall allow authorized merchants to issue full or partial refunds on confirmed payments.

Title: Transaction History
Description: The system shall provide users and merchants with chronological, paginated history of their respective transactions.

Title: Wallet Balance Query
Description: The system shall return the real-time verified balance of the authenticated user's wallet.

Title: Admin Audit Inspection
Description: The system shall allow authorized administrators to view, filter, and inspect immutable system audit logs.

Title: Security Alert Query
Description: The system shall enable administrators to retrieve security alerts regarding replay attempts and double spending.

Title: Transaction Latency
Description: The payment gateway shall process atomic payment transactions within 500 milliseconds under normal load.

Title: System Availability
Description: The simulator shall maintain 99.9% uptime during operational testing windows.

Title: Data Consistency
Description: The system persistence store shall adhere strictly to ACID properties with READ_COMMITTED isolation.

Title: Scalability & Containerization
Description: The backend and frontend services shall be containerized and deployable to Kubernetes with resource quotas.

Title: Maintainability & Code Quality
Description: The codebase shall maintain 0 high/critical SonarQube issues and high test coverage on core payment paths.

Title: Audit Immutability
Description: Audit log records shall be append-only and protected against retroactive alteration or deletion.

Title: Password Protection
Description: Passwords shall be hashed using BCrypt (factor 12) with unique cryptographic salts. Plaintext passwords shall never be persisted.

Title: Stateless JWT Authentication
Description: Session tokens shall be stateless HMAC-SHA256 signed JWTs with expiration time enforced server-side.

Title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
Description: Endpoints shall enforce strict roles (ROLE_USER, ROLE_MERCHANT, ROLE_ADMIN). Admin APIs shall reject non-admin tokens.

Title: Object-Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR)
Description: Users and merchants shall be strictly prohibited from accessing foreign wallets, payments, or transaction records.

Title: Double Spending Prevention
Description: Concurrent payment requests attempting to overdraft a wallet shall be serialized using pessimistic database locks.

Title: Idempotency Enforcement
Description: Payment endpoints shall require an Idempotency-Key. Repeated requests within 24 hours shall return identical cached responses.

Title: Replay Attack Protection
Description: Requests reusing an idempotency key with modified payloads shall be rejected immediately as tampered replays.

Title: Input Validation & Sanitization
Description: All API inputs (amounts, IDs, strings) shall be validated server-side. Negative or NaN amounts shall be rejected.

Title: Immutable Audit Logging
Description: All security-critical actions (logins, debits, refunds, auth failures, replays) shall generate immutable audit records.

Title: Sensitive Data Scrubbing
Description: Passwords, credit card numbers, and secret keys shall never be printed in application logs or audit stores.
